faces.transcription:
A WATCHFUL SKY

“The satellites above will observe your movements; your aliases could be compromised if you are not cautious.”

RIGHT NOW
1 Put the 5 enclosed Satellite tokens to the side of the board to form a supply.
2 Add the 12 enclosed Disease cubes to the supply.
3 Set the enclosed Satellite cards to the side for now. You’ll use them during setup.
4 Add the enclosed stickers to the rulebook.
